additional_info.subject: ID0483565-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/T4314241502060] Charger Status Appears Unavailable CRM:02681001609
additional_info.body:
Hi Emre-abi, good morning.
This is the ticket that you requested support yesterday.
I managed to revert the EcoG update to 1.4.11 and it's working. Please be aware that the StopTransaction HF is no longer there.
I will let the customer know that the problem is fixed but I would recommend reaching out to the colleague that installed the 1.4.20 and refer to them that the update sent the charger inoperational.
I will convey to the customer that the charger is working again.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0483565-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/T4314241502060] Charger Status Appears Unavailable CRM:02681001609
additional_info.body:
Hello Sahin, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
Sorry for the delay, I managed to fix the station yesterday. There was a minor FW error and now it should not happen again.
I forwarded this information to the regional colleagues as well, so that they are aware of the case.
I will proceed to close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: NOTE FROM L3 - Solution
additional_info.body:
EcoG 1.4.20 caused this error and there is no indication why.
Reinstalled v1.4.11 - since this is opened via portal I leave this solution note here.
